'''Archival Square''' was a section of the [[Axial Park]] district of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. The [[Korvalus Tower]], [[Gowix Corp superstructure]], and the [[Tyrelli Habitat]] were among the buildings that bordered the square, and the [[Museum Republica]] and the [[Corellian Museum of Starships]] were located there.
